Runner, producer, Docker and correctness outcomes remain separate. integrity_verified is not a correctness pass.

No remote commands, graph execution, result-certificate verification, source rebuild, Parquet recomputation or performance/causal verdict.
Trusted campaign profile and locally collected artifacts are assumed; not an adversarial untrusted-input parser/security certification.
